name: swim-report
description: Estimated beach hazard flag status for US beaches — swim.report

scripts.seed: DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/discovery-batch.js --layers ./.layers --out ./.seed.sql && node scripts/apply-local-sql.js ./.seed.sql
scripts.seed:marine: wrangler d1 execute swim-report --local --json --command "SELECT id, lat, lon, nws_zone, marine_zone FROM beaches" > .marine-snapshot.json && DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/discovery-batch.js --no-discovery --no-classify --marine-zones data/marine-zones-greatlakes.json --snapshot .marine-snapshot.json --out .marine.sql && node scripts/apply-local-sql.js .marine.sql
scripts.seed:waveplanes: find ./.wavegrids -name '*.grib2' -print | sort | while read -r f; do gdalinfo -json "$f" > "$f.info.json"; done && DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/sample-waves.js --mode plan --dest ./.wavegrids --out ./.wavegrids/band-plan.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const dir='./.wavegrids/planes';const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./.wavegrids/band-plan.json','utf8'));fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});for(const e of p.entries){const img=dir+'/'+e.key+'.img';if(e.warp){const vrt=dir+'/'+e.key+'.vrt';cp.execFileSync('gdal_translate',['-q','-of','VRT','-b',String(e.band),e.sourceFile,vrt],{stdio:'inherit'});cp.execFileSync('gdalwarp',['-q','-overwrite','-t_srs',e.warp.targetSrs,'-te'].concat(e.warp.te.map(String),['-tr'],e.warp.tr.map(String),['-r',e.warp.resample,'-dstnodata',String(e.nodata),'-ot','Float32','-of','ENVI',vrt,img]),{stdio:'inherit'});}else{cp.execFileSync('gdal_translate',['-q','-of','ENVI','-ot','Float32','-b',String(e.band),e.sourceFile,img],{stdio:'inherit'});}fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/'+e.key+'.info.json',cp.execFileSync('gdalinfo',['-json','-stats',img]));}console.log('extracted '+p.entries.length+' plane(s)');"
scripts.seed:waves: wrangler d1 execute swim-report --local --json --command "SELECT id, lat, lon, water_class, last_viewed FROM beaches WHERE $(DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read scripts/print-flag-worthy-sql.js) ORDER BY id" > .wave-snapshot.json && DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/sample-waves.js --mode sample --dest ./.wavegrids --planes ./.wavegrids/planes --snapshot .wave-snapshot.json --out ./.wavegrids/out && DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env=ImageOS,ImageVersion scripts/build-wave-manifest.js --sample ./.wavegrids/out --grids-report ./.wavegrids/grids-report.json --expect data/wave-grids.json --floors data/wave-floors.json --cycle-id local --out ./.wavegrids/out/manifest.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./.wavegrids/out/manifest.json','utf8'));fs.writeFileSync('./.wavegrids/current.json',JSON.stringify({cycleId:m.cycleId,prefix:'waves/'+m.cycleId}))" && DENO_NO_PACKAGE_JSON=1 deno run --allow-read --allow-write scripts/build-wave-kv.js --mode emit --dir ./.wavegrids/out --pointer ./.wavegrids/current.json --out ./.wavekv && for f in ./.wavekv/wave-kv-*.json; do wrangler kv bulk put "$f" --local --binding FLAGS; done
